articles.title: Farage Wins Clacton By-Election, Then Vanishes: What's He Hiding?
articles.summary: Nigel Farage won the Clacton by-election but skipped the declaration, citing a police warning about disruption. His absence has fueled speculation that he's dodging questions about Reform UK's finances, which triggered the election in the first place.

articles.title: Speed Cameras Spread to More States, and Drivers Are Fighting Back
articles.summary: As speed cameras proliferate in school zones across the U.S., drivers are pushing back, calling them a 'money grab.' Safety advocates say they save lives, but critics argue they're an illegal tax—and the Trump administration has sided with the critics.

articles.title: UK Bans Disposable BBQs as Wildfire Risk Soars During Heatwave
articles.summary: The UK government has temporarily banned the sale of disposable barbecues in England, Scotland, and Wales, citing a 'significant risk to the public' as drought and heatwave conditions fuel wildfires. The move comes as the country matches last year's record of 1,017 wildfires.
